summary: First end-to-end test run for Solar Credit Tracker MVP. All 16 backend pytest cases and every UI flow specified in the review request passed. Database left with a fresh 30-day seed and owner_name restored to 'GeeBin A R' for the demo.

issues: Radix DialogContent is missing aria-describedby (a11y console warning). Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby on the DialogContent in History.jsx (View + Edit dialogs) to satisfy Radix a11y requirements.

action_items: Optional: silence Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warnings by adding DialogDescription to History.jsx dialogs.
Optional: install `willReadFrequently: true` on Chart canvases to suppress Chrome Canvas2D warning (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_recalculate_chain` reads all readings and writes each row back individually - fine for MVP scale but O(N) writes per mutation; consider bulk_write for large datasets.

POST /api/readings computes previous_export from the chronologically-previous row but does NOT reject a NEW reading whose date is BETWEEN two existing rows and whose current_export is LESS than the next row's current_export (would create a negative delta on the following row after recompute). update_reading covers that via post-recalc check; consider mirroring the same guard on create when inserting in the middle of the chain.
Duplicate-code smell: KPI icons/tones defined in multiple files (Dashboard, Reports, Backup). Extract shared 'tones' map into a util if project grows.
Frontend calls `/settings` on every route change (Layout useEffect on location.pathname) - could be cached in ThemeContext or a settings context.
seed_data_creation: Database re-seeded to 30 days via POST /api/seed?days=30 as the final action. Owner name restored to 'GeeBin A R' via PUT /api/settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comprehensive backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (single TestSolarBackend class, tests numbered 01-16 for deterministic order under xdist loadscope). Frontend Playwright script covers dashboard, reading-form validation, history, reports (PDF/Excel/CSV downloads all trigger), analytics (4 canvases), settings persistence and backup seed/wipe. Only cosmetic Radix a11y warnings and Canvas2D perf warnings observed - no functional issues.
